BREVLIN S40 PORTABLE SPEAKER - SETUP GUIDE
Version 1.3. This guide applies to the Brevlin S40 portable Bluetooth speaker.

1. INTRODUCTION

Thank you for choosing the Brevlin S40. This guide explains how to unpack the speaker, charge it, pair it with a phone, laptop or tablet, and adjust the sound. Read the safety section before the first use and keep this guide together with your warranty card.

2. WHAT IS IN THE BOX

- One Brevlin S40 speaker
- One USB-C charging cable, 1 m long
- One quick start card
- One carrying handle

Check the contents of the box. If anything is missing or damaged, contact your retailer before you use the speaker.

3. CONTROLS AND PORTS

The top panel has five buttons: Power, Bluetooth, Volume up, Volume down and Play/Pause. The Bluetooth button also answers and ends calls when the speaker is connected to a phone. The rear panel has the charging port and the auxiliary input. The status LED sits behind the front grille, next to the handle.

4. CHARGING THE SPEAKER

Charge the speaker fully before the first use. Connect the USB-C cable to the rear port and to a USB power adapter rated at 5 V or 9 V. The status LED glows solid yellow while the battery charges and turns off when the battery is full. A full charge takes about five hours.

Notes:

- The speaker accepts a 9 V adapter for faster charging, but the battery reaches full charge only with a 5 V adapter.
- Do not charge the speaker while the housing or the port is wet.
- Charging stops automatically at 100 percent. You do not need to unplug the speaker early.

5. STATUS LED

The LED shows the current state of the speaker:

- Flashes violet: the speaker is ready to pair with a device.
- Solid green: the speaker is connected to a device.
- Flashes orange: the battery is low. Charge the speaker before you continue.
- Solid yellow: the battery is charging.

6. PAIRING WITH A DEVICE

Step 1. Make sure the speaker is charged. Press the Power button to switch the speaker on.

Step 2. Press and hold the Bluetooth button for 5 seconds, until the LED flashes violet. Release the button when the LED starts to flash.

Step 3. On your phone or laptop, open the Bluetooth settings and select "Brevlin S40" from the list of devices.

Step 4. Wait until the LED turns solid green. The speaker now plays audio from the device.

The speaker can keep up to 8 devices in its memory. When a ninth device pairs, the device that has been stored the longest is removed from the list. To reconnect a device that is already stored, select the speaker name on that device and confirm the connection.

Warning: Do not hold the Bluetooth button for longer than 8 seconds during pairing, because the speaker may switch to standby and you must start again.

7. SPECIFICATIONS

Output power ........... 30 W RMS
Battery life ........... up to 20 hours at medium volume
Charging port .......... USB-C
Bluetooth version ...... 5.3
Paired devices ......... up to 8 devices in memory
Water resistance ....... IPX7, submersible up to 1 m for 30 minutes
Weight ................. 1.2 kg
Operating temperature .. 0 C to 40 C

The battery is built in. Battery life depends on the volume level, the audio content and the age of the battery. Battery life figures are measured with the speaker at 50 percent volume.

8. PLAYING AUDIO

Press Power to switch the speaker on. Start playback on your device. Use the Volume up and Volume down buttons on the speaker to change the level, or use the volume control on the connected device. Press Play/Pause to start or stop playback from the speaker controls. The speaker switches to standby after 20 minutes without a connection or audio signal.

To use a wired source, connect a 3.5 mm cable to the auxiliary input on the rear panel. The speaker switches to the auxiliary input automatically when a cable is detected, and it returns to Bluetooth when the cable is removed.

9. SAFETY

- Do not expose the speaker to temperatures above 40 C, for example inside a parked car in summer.
- Do not place the speaker on a heater or near an open flame.
- Do not open the housing. The battery is built in and must be replaced only by an authorised service centre.
- The IPX7 rating protects the speaker against temporary immersion. Do not use the speaker in hot water, in salt water or in a swimming pool with chemicals.

Warning: A swollen battery, a burning smell or leaking liquid means the speaker must be switched off and taken to a service centre at once.

10. CARE AND CLEANING

Wipe the outside of the speaker with a soft, dry cloth. For stubborn marks, use a cloth that is slightly damp with water. Do not use solvents, alcohol or abrasive cleaners, because they can damage the grille and the coating. After any immersion, dry the port cover and the grille with a cloth and let the speaker air-dry for two hours before you charge it. Store the speaker in a cool, dry place when you do not use it for several weeks, and charge it to about half before storage.
